title: Odds-Shift Slippage in One-vs-Rest Rankers: Diagnosing and Repairing Reweighting-Induced Top-K Errors (code, results and paper sources)
description: Code, canonical result files, the oddslip library and the LaTeX sources (arXiv and archived long versions) of the paper on odds-shift slippage: the gap between the log-odds shift a per-label class weight promises and the shift a finite one-vs-rest learner realizes, its effect on top-K ranking, and its repair by per-label calibration with an explicit prior fallback.
